paras: Our class takes a [[bus|bus]] from the school to the main [[station|station]] in the [[city|city]]. Everyone keeps a small map.
At the station, our teacher gives each student a [[ticket|ticket]]. We walk two streets and arrive at the [[museum|museum]].
Inside, an old map shows the [[history|history]] of the city. I learn that a market once stood where our school is today.
zh: 我们班从学校乘公交车前往市中心的车站。每个人都拿着一张小地图。
在车站，老师给每位学生一张票。我们走过两条街，来到博物馆。
博物馆里的一张老地图展示了这座城市的历史。我了解到，我们学校所在的位置过去曾是一个市场。

q.s: The class starts its trip at school.
q.why: They take a bus from the school.

q.s: The museum is inside the station.
q.why: They walk two streets from the station to the museum.

q.s: The old market closed fifty years ago.
